about: The words and phrases no sentence Observer builds for an assessment may use, because they read as a clearance (depth plan section 13, limit 3: a result with nothing in it is not a clearance). One list for both sides: internal/secassess/reading_test.go (Go) and web/src/lib/secAssessModel.test.ts, web/src/components/secassess/AssessModelView.test.tsx and web/e2e/security-assessments.spec.ts (TypeScript) read this file. A word matches whole, in any case; a phrase matches with any run of spaces between its words. The categories of Observer's own vocabulary (for example Vulnerability analysis) are names, not claims, which is why the bare word vulnerability is not on the list.
allowed: No weakness was reported in what was tested
